newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu to launch new sport-utility model.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu to launch new sport-utility model.

text.p: Isuzu Motors Ltd said on Monday it will launch a new sport-utility vehicle, named "VehiCROSS," in Japan on April 26.

The four-wheel-drive car, powered by a 3.2-litre V6 gasoline engine, will use plastic panels for the lower part of body and a "Torque On Demand" electronically-controlled four-wheel-drive (4WD) system, Isuzu said.
Isuzu, owned 37.4 percent by General Motors Corp, hopes to sell 200 units per month. Japanese retail price will be 2.95 million yen in the Tokyo area.
Isuzu has no plans yet to export the new model but will monitor the response to the new model at the New York car show this week and decide, an Isuzu spokesman said.
